data.long_meaning: Parinda is a beautiful name in Arabic and Urdu, derived from the words for 'butterfly' and 'bird'. This name is often given to girls born during the springtime, as a symbol of new life and renewal. It is also a reminder of the fleeting nature of life and the importance of living in the present moment. The name Parinda carries the meaning “Butterfly, Bird” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Parinda usually hope their child will grow to embody butterfly, bird and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It is said to represent the soul's journey through life, with the butterfly symbolizing transformation and rebirth, and the bird symbolizing freedom and the ability to soar above life's challenges.
